scenarios.title: Tool timeout during commit
scenarios.covers: Commit has no remote tool in this architecture: it revalidates policy and writes SQLite locally. Failure semantics are enforced by tests: commit before confirmation returns 409, an invalid revalidation returns 409 and moves the call to NEGOTIATION, and the confirmation/idempotency paths never report success before the write completes.
